title: The pulses preserving useful exchange also preserve its hidden bath modulation
statement: For H=J*H_ex tensor(I+Z_M) and T=pi/(8J), the +Z bath sector transfers by SWAP while the -Z sector has no exchange; every collective Pauli pulse commutes with H, so arbitrarily many cycles leave the difference unchanged.

requires: The exact three-qubit Hamiltonian and the proposed collective Pauli control group.
provides: For H=J*H_ex tensor(I+Z_M) and T=pi/(8J), the +Z bath sector transfers by SWAP while the -Z sector has no exchange; every collective Pauli pulse commutes with H, so arbitrarily many cycles leave the difference unchanged.
assumptions: This refutes extending the stated closure theorem to unbounded/unexcluded exchange modulation. It does not refute the narrower single-site-nuisance theorem or every other physical controller.
costs: More of the same cycles cannot identify/exclude the hidden sector. A justified extra coupling bound u costs at most u*T by Duhamel, or an actual larger boundary/changed architecture is needed.
contract.units: hbar=1 in the stated exchange model: J,v are inverse-time scales, kappa has inverse-time squared units, T,w are times, q/delta are dimensionless channel/error allowances. Counts and source-model time are not laboratory throughput.
contract.obstruction: Justify actual interaction class, uniform pulse/isolation/trusted-instrument bounds and output routing. A fresh independent Bell input with isolated reference witnesses entanglement under q<1/2, but no quantum capacity, fault-tolerance threshold, practical advantage, uncut environment simulator or unlimited service follows.

body: In bath+Z, coupling is2J and the declared duration gives full SWAP. In bath-Z, coupling is0 and local pulses alone cannot transfer an unknown quantum state. The group commutes with the task generator and with its bath-multiplied copy. Successful calibration confined to+Z cannot certify deployment on-Z. The obstruction is an unacquired interaction/interface, not a numerical cutoff or inadequate record precision.
